# cdb command reference

One page per command, generated from the registry the binary itself runs on.
For a task-shaped introduction read the [user guide](../UserGuide.md).

A command marked **shell only** exists inside the interactive shell and has no
`cdb <name>` form. A command marked **destructive** asks for confirmation
before it acts, unless `--yes` is given.

## Global flags

Every one-shot subcommand accepts these, before or after its own flags.
Inside the shell only `--json`, `--yes`, `--verbose` and `--anonymous` are
accepted on a line; the rest have shell equivalents (`connect`, `cd`) or are
read from `config.toml` for the whole session.

| Flag | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `--anonymous` | bool | `false` | connect without credentials, and do not ask for any |
| `--color` | string |  | colour: auto, always or never |
| `--format` | string |  | output format: table or json |
| `--json` | bool | `false` | print raw JSON instead of a table |
| `--pager` | string |  | pager command, or off |
| `--path` | string |  | starting virtual path |
| `--profile` | string |  | connection profile to use, overriding CDB_PROFILE and the default |
| `--url` | string |  | server URL, overriding the profile and CDB_URL |
| `--verbose` | bool | `false` | include raw status codes and reasons in errors |
| `--yes` | bool | `false` | skip confirmation prompts |
